A '''[[Tythonian War Droid]]''' guarded the grave of the [[Weapon Master]] on the planet [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. It directed the [[The Barsen'thor|Padawan]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yuon Par]] to a set of challenges in order to be granted access to the hilt of the [[First Blade]].
